operations.description: Create a user contact group (contactGroups.create; canonical operation only, see README).
Delete a user contact group, optionally deleting the contacts whose only group it was (DELETE /v1/contactGroups/{resourceName}).
Read one contact group, optionally with up to maxMembers member resource names (GET /v1/contactGroups/{resourceName}).
List the caller's contact groups, system groups first (GET /v1/contactGroups).
Add or remove contacts in a contact group (POST /v1/contactGroups/{resourceName}/members:modify).
Deploy a project at a version or at HEAD, deriving the entry point from its manifest (POST /v1/projects/{scriptId}/deployments).
List a project's deployments, newest first (GET /v1/projects/{scriptId}/deployments).
Read a stored long-running operation produced by a subscriptions mutation (GET /v1/operations/{name}).
List the caller's other contacts: addresses seen in mail but never saved (GET /v1/otherContacts).
Create a private contact, adding it to myContacts and to any requested contact group (POST /v1/people:createContact).
Delete a private contact and write a tombstone so sync tokens report the deletion (DELETE /v1/people/{resourceName}:deleteContact).
Read one person: the caller's own profile (people/me), a private contact (people/c…) or a colleague's domain profile (GET /v1/people/{resourceName}).
List the caller's contacts with paging, sort order and People sync tokens (GET /v1/people/me/connections).
Search the caller's contacts by name, nickname, e-mail, phone digits or organisation (people:searchContacts; canonical operation only, see README).
Update the masked fields of a private contact; the caller must send the person's current etag (PATCH /v1/people/{resourceName}:updateContact).
List the caller's own script executions, newest first, with the API's user process filter (GET /v1/processes).
Create an Apps Script project seeded with a `Code` file and the `appsscript` manifest (POST /v1/projects).
Read an Apps Script project's metadata (GET /v1/projects/{scriptId}).
Read the files of a project's HEAD content or of a numbered version (GET /v1/projects/{scriptId}/content).
Replace a project's HEAD content wholesale and recompute each file's function set (PUT /v1/projects/{scriptId}/content).
Freeze the current HEAD content as a new immutable version (POST /v1/projects/{scriptId}/versions).
Run a function through the simulated one-expression Apps Script runtime and record the execution (POST /v1/scripts/{scriptId}:run).
Subscribe to events on a Chat space, Drive item or Meet space; returns the long-running-operation envelope (POST /v1/subscriptions).
Delete a subscription, optionally guarded by its etag (DELETE /v1/subscriptions/{name}).
Read one of the caller's subscriptions (GET /v1/subscriptions/{name}).
List the caller's subscriptions matching a filter on event_types and target_resource (GET /v1/subscriptions).
Reactivate a suspended subscription whose suspension reason allows it (POST /v1/subscriptions/{name}:reactivate).

connections.title: Google API client (test process)
connections.instructions: Point each API's root URL at GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_BASE_URL plus its service prefix (/people/v1, /workspaceevents/v1, /script/v1) and send GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_TOKEN as the Bearer token. Test processes only; no Google service is contacted.
